trace.notes: Normalized the input as the zbMATH document URL https://zbmath.org/682595. Local shell fetching could not resolve zbmath.org or api.zbmath.org because network access is unavailable in the execution sandbox. Local shard metadata identifies zbMATH record 682595 as Joseph O'Rourke, 'Computational geometry column 23: Open problems', published in 1994, with DOI 10.1142/S0218195994000148.

Access failure mode: metadata_only with blocked_or_challenged resolver behavior. The zbMATH URL and zbMATH API could not be fetched from the shell. DOI and dx.doi.org resolution attempts failed in the page reader. DBLP confirmed the exact work as 'Computational geometry column 23', International Journal of Computational Geometry & Applications 4(2), pages 239-242 (1994), and exposed DOI/unpaywall resolver links, but those resolver links did not yield a readable PDF or full HTML body.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched for the exact title, exact DOI, DOI suffix, title plus PDF, title plus tetrahedralization, and the SIGACT reprint metadata. Recovered pages were bibliographic metadata, abstract-only records, table-of-contents entries, author bibliography entries, or related later problem-list pages rather than a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML article containing the 1994 problem statements.
No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source artifact was recovered. Metadata and abstract snippets were not treated as the technical source.

The source-adequacy and evidence-completeness gates forbid accepting questions extracted only from abstracts, citation metadata, bibliographies, table-of-contents pages, search snippets, or related-but-distinct problem-list pages. The run therefore remains in needs_review with accepted empty.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/682595.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
